extracted.intended_audience: graphic designers, web developers, vendors, and partners who place or reproduce the World Vision logo (internal and external sites)
extracted.subtask_description: Web/digital usage rules for the World Vision logo: required artwork sources, placement, background, protected space, linking behavior, and prohibition on alternate marks or separated elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single logo policy
rubrics_metrics.description: World Vision has only one logo. No other logo or graphic mark may be used to advertise, market, or communicate a World Vision product or project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not create or adopt alternate logos or graphic marks to represent World Vision or its products/projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo integrity — show all elements together
rubrics_metrics.description: All of the graphic elements (horizon, logotype, cross/star, white background, and registration mark) must always be shown together as displayed here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: None of the constituent elements of the logo may be shown separately in any context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use original artwork (do not recreate)
rubrics_metrics.description: The World Vision logo must always be reproduced from the original .eps vector or original .jpg bitmap artwork.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Never recreate the World Vision logo from scratch or alter the artwork; always use the provided master files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo placement on websites
rubrics_metrics.description: The World Vision logo should always appear in the upper left corner of the website, with the horizontal tagline 'lock-up'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On web templates and pages, position the logo in the upper-left and use the specified horizontal lock-up version (tagline orientation) unless alternate lock-ups are explicitly provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: External-site linking requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: When the World Vision logo is used on external sites, the logo should always link to worldvision.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that any third-party or partner site hosting the logo provides a link from the logo to worldvision.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo background requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The World Vision logo must always appear on a solid white background.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not place the logo over photographs, colored backgrounds, gradients, or patterned surfaces; reserve a solid white field for logo placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protected space / padding
rubrics_metrics.description: The World Vision logo must always have adequate 'padding' around the edges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified measurements (provided below on the original guide) to ensure adequate protected space between the logo and any surrounding text or images.
